DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の経路について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友達は長く歩きたいですが、私は途中で休みたいです。別々に歩いても、帰りに合流できる場所を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩行希望差がある友人と別経路後の帰宅合流地点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend wants a long walk, but I want to rest along the way. We want to choose somewhere to meet on the way back, even if we walk separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to meet your friend on the way home after taking different routes because you want different walking distances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人とも分かる、動かない目印を選ぶとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: A fixed landmark that both of you recognize would be a good choice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の名前が読めるので、そこで待とうと思います。移動する屋台の所より分かりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 読める入口を選び可動屋台でなく固定目印と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can read the entrance name, so I think I will wait there. It is easier to identify than a mobile food stall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose an entrance whose name you can read as a fixed landmark instead of a movable stall. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その入口へ戻る道も、案内図で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the map for the way back to that entrance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。長く歩く友達の経路を全部まねず、自分が戻れる範囲を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の長経路を模倣せず自己戻れる範囲を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check how far I can go and still get back, instead of copying my friend’s entire long route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the area you can return from instead of following your friend’s long route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの時刻も、お二人で確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you both agreed on a meeting time too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これから決めます。「疲れたら戻る」だけでは、友達がいつ戻るか分からないので、時間も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 疲れたら戻るだけでなく具体時刻を二人で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will decide now. Just saying “come back when you are tired” would leave me unsure when my friend will return, so we will discuss a time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will both discuss a specific time instead of just returning when tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待つ場所や時刻を変える場合は、相手にも連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you change the waiting place or time, please let the other person know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。入口名と時間を二人で決め、途中で予定を変えたら連絡します。自分は短い経路で休みながら歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口名時刻を共有し変更時連絡し自己短経路を歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We will agree on the entrance name and time, and I will contact my friend if plans change along the way. I will take a short route and rest as I walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share the entrance name and time, contact your friend about changes, and take a short route yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内図をご確認ください。お二人とも散歩をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the map, then. Enjoy your walks, both of you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの予定について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss your return plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行を一日延ばしたくなりました。ただ、宿へ連絡する前に、明日の帰りの切符をどうすればよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿泊一日延長前に予約済翌日帰路券の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to extend my trip by one day. But before contacting my accommodation, I want to ask what to do with my return ticket for tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with your booked return ticket for tomorrow before extending your stay by one day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの切符と、新しく考えている日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your ticket and tell me the new date you are considering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。明後日に帰りたいです。宿が延ばせるだけで、この切符もそのまま使えるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券を示し明後日希望で宿延長を券有効と同一視しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I want to return the day after tomorrow. I do not assume I can use this ticket unchanged just because my accommodation can extend my stay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your ticket, say you want to return the day after tomorrow, and explain that extending your stay does not mean the ticket remains valid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符の種類と条件を確認して、変更などの方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the ticket type and conditions and explain options such as changing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ新しい切符は買っていません。今の切符の扱いと、明後日の移動を両方知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未新規購入で元券と新移動双方の確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have not bought a new ticket yet. I want to know both what to do with this ticket and how to travel the day after tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not bought a new ticket and want to check both the original ticket and the new journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望する列車の案内も確認しましょう。お帰りの時刻に制約はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check information on the train you want too. Are there any limits on your return time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 翌日は仕事なので、夜遅くなるのは避けたいです。旅行を延ばすことだけでなく、家へ着く予定も考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日勤務制約で旅行延長だけでなく帰宅時刻も考えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I work the following day, so I want to avoid getting back late at night. Besides extending my trip, I want to consider when I will arrive home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you work the following day and want to consider your arrival time at home as well as extending your trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更できる条件と移動の案内を聞いてから、ご予定をお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please decide your plans after hearing the conditions for changes and the travel information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。切符と帰宅時刻を確認し、それから宿の空きも聞きます。どちらかが難しければ、元の予定で帰ることも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券時刻と宿の空きを順に聞き不可なら元予定保持も検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the ticket and arrival time, then ask about room availability. If either is difficult, I will also consider returning as originally planned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the ticket, times, then accommodation availability, and consider keeping your original plan if either is impossible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、切符を確認します。引き続きご旅行をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check your ticket now. Enjoy the rest of your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの説明で、もう一度確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything from the earlier explanation you would like to check again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族へ、希望どおり決まったと送ってしまいました。まだ担当の確認を待つのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族へ確定と送ったが担当確認待ちか再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I already told my family that everything was settled as I hoped. We are actually still waiting for the staff member to check, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check again whether staff confirmation is still pending, after telling your family it was settled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、申請を受け付けた段階です。結果は確認の後にお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, we have only accepted your application. We will inform you of the result after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族には今すぐ、結果はまだ出ていないと訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未決定の状態を家族へ訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will tell my family right now that I was mistaken and the result is not out yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will correct what you told your family because no decision has been made. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 結果の連絡は、申請書に書かれた電話番号へ差し上げる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We plan to contact you with the result at the telephone number on your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この番号は私の携帯です。仕事中に出られなかった場合は、どうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己携帯を連絡先として不在着信時の方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is my mobile number. What should I do if I cannot answer while working?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify your mobile as the contact number and ask what to do if you miss a call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 着信に気づいたら、こちらの担当窓口へおかけ直しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you notice the missed call, please call this department back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。かけ直す時に伝えるため、申請の受付番号も控えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 折返時に使う受付番号を控えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will also note my application receipt number so I can give it when I call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will note the receipt number to use when returning the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お知らせした番号と、お名前をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give the number we provided and your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。連絡先と受付番号をこの控えにまとめました。結果の連絡を受けたら家族へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先受付番号を整理し結果受領後家族へ報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I have put the contact details and receipt number together on this copy. Once I hear the result, I will tell my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have organized the contact details and receipt number and will inform your family after receiving the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当からの連絡をお待ちください。お越しいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait for the staff member to contact you, then. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診療担当へ追加で伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything else you want to tell the medical staff?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき「いつも痛い」と書きましたが、ずっと痛みがあるわけではありません。言い方を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 常時でない症状をいつもと記入したため言換補足を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote “it always hurts” earlier, but the pain is not continuous. I want to correct how I described it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to rephrase and add details because you wrote “always” for symptoms that are not constant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際には、どのような時に気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: When do you actually notice it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日は夕方と夜で、今日は朝に気になりました。間に気にならない時間もありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕夜と今朝の症状と無症状間隔を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday I noticed it in the evening and at night, and today in the morning. There were also periods in between when I did not notice it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the symptoms yesterday evening, last night and this morning, and the symptom-free intervals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過を診療担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain that course of events to the medical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。「よくある」というつもりで「いつも」と書きました。痛みが途切れないと伝わると違うので、補足したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 高頻度意図を連続痛と誤伝達しないため補足すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I meant “often” when I wrote “always.” I want to add details because it would be inaccurate to suggest that the pain never stops.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to add details so frequent pain is not mistaken for continuous pain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かった範囲で、時刻や続いた時間も説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also explain the times and how long it lasted, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正確な分数は覚えていません。分からない所を作らず、覚えている時間帯から話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 継続分数は不明で時間帯のみ正確に伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not remember the exact number of minutes. I will not invent what I do not know; I will start with the times of day I remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not know the duration in minutes and will accurately report only the times of day you remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の状態についても、担当にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the staff about your current condition too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今は気になっていませんが、昨日から今日のことは話します。今ないことだけで、前の症状までなかったとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在無症状でも過去経過を消さず診察で伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. It is not bothering me now, but I will explain what happened yesterday and today. Just because it is absent now does not mean the earlier symptoms never happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will describe the earlier course at the consultation even without symptoms now, without denying the past symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、補足のご希望を担当へ伝えます。診察までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the staff you want to add information. Please wait for your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道の状態について、お知らせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you reporting the condition of a road?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩いていた道に石が落ちていました。山から落ちた物かは分かりませんが、車が通るので伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車道上石を観察し山からの落石か未確認だが報告希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There were stones on the road where I was walking. I do not know whether they fell from the mountain, but cars use the road, so I want to report it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report stones you saw on a road used by cars, while saying you have not confirmed whether they fell from the mountain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その場からは離れていますか。場所を示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you moved away from the spot? Can you show us where it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 離れています。ここに写真があります。石を動かして調べたわけではなく、道の脇から撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退避済で石未移動の路側写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have moved away. Here is a photo. I did not move the stones to investigate; I took it from the roadside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have moved to safety and show a roadside photo taken without moving the stones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いつご覧になりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一時間ほど前です。写真に見える状態が今も同じとは限らないので、その時刻も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一時間前観察で現在状態は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: About an hour ago. The situation in the photo may not still be the same, so I will give you that time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you saw it an hour ago and have not checked the current condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 近くの目印や、道の名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know any nearby landmarks or the road name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道の名前は読めませんでした。写真の看板と、地図で歩いた経路を一緒に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道名未読だが看板写真と歩行地図で位置特定を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I could not read the road name. I would like you to look at the sign in my photo together with my walking route on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for help locating the spot using a sign photo and walking map, because you could not read the road name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる場所の情報を伺い、関係する担当への連絡を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask for the location details you can confirm and check how to notify the relevant staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。大きな崩れが起きたとは言わず、私が見た石と位置を説明します。追加の写真を撮るためには戻りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大崩落と断定せず観察石のみ説明し再撮影へ戻らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will describe the stones and location I saw without claiming there was a major collapse. I will not go back to take more photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will describe only the stones you observed without claiming a major collapse, and will not return for more photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせの場所を確認します。それでは、こちらで経路をご説明ください。お帰りもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the location you reported. Please explain your route here. Take care on your way back too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの手紙は、全部今日お出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending all these letters today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一通だけ出したいです。旅の各日に書いたので、残りは明日と明後日に分けて出そうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 各旅行日に書いた三通を別日差出したく今日は一通のみと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send just one. I wrote them on different days of my trip, so I plan to send the others separately tomorrow and the day after.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you wrote three letters on different trip days and want to mail them on different days, with only one today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日お出しになるものを、分けてお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please separate out the one you want to send today and show me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。封筒が同じ色なので、三通全部を渡さないよう日付のメモを別に付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同色封筒を日付別メモで分け当日対象を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one. The envelopes are the same color, so I attached separate date notes to avoid handing over all three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show today’s letter, explaining that you separated same-colored envelopes with dated notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お手元に残す物も、宛先や内容をご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the addresses and contents of the ones you are keeping yourself too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。今日の手紙の中の日付は、書いた日のことです。出した日や届く日と同じ意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本文日付は作成日で差出日配達日と同義でないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The date inside today’s letter is the date I wrote it. It does not mean the same thing as the mailing or delivery date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the date in the letter is its writing date, not its mailing or delivery date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発送方法について、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a preferred mailing method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普通に送りたいですが、一日ずつ出せば必ず一日ずつ届くとは限らないのですね。その点も案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別日差出が別日配達保証にならない点を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to send them by ordinary mail, but sending one each day does not guarantee they will arrive one day apart, right? I would like information on that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that mailing on separate days does not guarantee delivery on separate days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配達の案内をご確認ください。差し出す予定どおりに届くことは、お約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the delivery information. We cannot promise they will arrive according to your mailing schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。友達には、旅の別の日に書いた手紙と伝えます。今日はこの一通だけ出し、未発送の二通は持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ執筆日区分を伝え一通のみ差出し未発送二通を保持すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will tell my friend they were written on different days of my trip. I will send only this one today and take the two unsent letters home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the different writing days to your friend, mail only one letter and keep the two unsent ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、この一通を確認します。お手元の手紙もお忘れなく。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check this one, then. Please do not forget the letters you are keeping. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金の記録について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to ask about the deposit record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が旅行費を返してくれました。でも、通帳に増えた行がないので、返してもらっていないのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族旅行費返金が通帳に見えず未精算か心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family paid me back for travel expenses. But there is no new line in my passbook, so I thought they might not have paid me back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern that the family travel reimbursement may be unsettled because it does not appear in your passbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お金は、どのように受け取られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: How did you receive the money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現金です。財布へ入れただけでした。家族から受け取ったことと、口座へ入れたことを同じに考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金財布受領を口座入金と混同したと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: In cash. I only put it in my wallet. I was treating receiving it from my family as the same as depositing it in my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit you confused receiving cash in your wallet with a bank-account deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ口座へ入金したお手続きは、されていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You have not yet made a deposit into your account, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。銀行に渡していません。通帳にないことを理由に、家族へもう一度払ってとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未銀行入金で記録なしを理由に家族へ二重請求しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I have not given the money to the bank. I will make sure not to ask my family to pay again just because it is not in the passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not deposited it at the bank and will not charge your family twice because there is no record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今後その現金を入金する方法については、ご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can explain how to deposit that cash later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。まず家族から受け取った金額を自分のメモで確認し、入金したい分を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取額を自己メモ照合し入金対象額を決める希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. First I will check the amount I received from my family against my own notes and decide how much I want to deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the amount received against your notes and decide how much to deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金額とご本人の口座を確認してから、お手続きをご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the amount and your own account before discussing the procedure with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族との精算は現金受取として残し、銀行への入金は別の記録にします。二重に数えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族現金精算と銀行入金記録を分け二重計上しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will record the settlement with my family as cash received and record the bank deposit separately. I will avoid counting it twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep separate records of the family cash settlement and bank deposit to avoid double counting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、入金の方法をご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will explain the deposit method now. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会員証について、何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your membership card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普段の店でもらった会員証です。看板の色が似ているので、ここでも割引になると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 類似看板色から常用店会員割引が旅先も適用と思い証を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is a membership card from my usual shop. The sign colors look similar, so I thought I could get a discount here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your usual shop’s membership card and say the similar sign color led you to expect a discount while traveling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この店舗で使える会員証か、確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check whether this membership card can be used at this branch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。店の名前をよく見ると少し違います。色だけで同じ店と考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店名相違に気づき色のみの同一視を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. Looking closely, the shop name is slightly different. I assumed it was the same shop just from the color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you noticed the different shop name and admit you assumed it was the same shop based only on the color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会員証の表示と、こちらの案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check what the card says and the information here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。使えない場合でも、表示されている値段で買うか考えたいです。先に割引済みの金額とは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不可なら表示価格で買うか考え割引額を前提にしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Even if I cannot use it, I want to consider buying at the displayed price. I will not assume a discounted amount beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will consider buying at the displayed price if the card is invalid, without assuming a discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる条件をお伝えしてから、お選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please make your choice after we explain the conditions we can confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会員証には名前があるので、見せた後は自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名入り証は提示後自分で持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. My name is on the card, so I will take it back myself after showing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take your named card home yourself after showing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計の前に、価格をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the price before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。証の対象と今日の価格を確認してから買います。普段の店のポイントまで増えたとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 証対象と当日価格後決定し常用店ポイントも自己断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will buy after checking where the card applies and today’s price. I will not assume my usual shop’s points have increased either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide after checking card eligibility and today’s price and will not assume you earned points at your usual shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、対象を確認します。お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check its eligibility, then. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水辺での撮影についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about taking photos by the water?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。石を積んだ写真を撮りたいです。ここにある石を少し動かしてよいか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水辺石積撮影のため自然物移動可否を未実施で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to photograph stacked stones. Before doing anything, I want to ask whether I may move a few stones here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before doing anything whether you may move natural stones to stack them for a waterside photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 水辺の物を動かす前に、利用案内をご確認ください。まだ石には触れていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the usage guidelines before moving things by the water. Have you touched the stones yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 触れていません。撮った後に戻すつもりならよいと思いましたが、元の場所も正確には覚えられませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触で撮後復元も正確原位置不明と気づきを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not. I thought it would be fine if I put them back after the photo, but I would not be able to remember their exact original positions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not touched them and realize you cannot restore their exact original positions even after the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の状態のまま、見たり撮ったりする方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also look at or photograph them as they are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですね。自分の好きな形にするのでなく、並んでいる石と水の様子を撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 加工せず現石配置と水を撮る代案を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is true. Instead of arranging them how I like, I want to photograph the stones as they lie and the water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to photograph the existing stone arrangement and water without altering them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水に入ったり、足元の不安定な場所へ近づいたりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not enter the water or approach places with unstable footing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。石を近くで撮るために水際まで行かず、通路から見える範囲にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水際へ近づかず通路可視範囲のみ撮影すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will keep to what I can see from the path, without going to the water’s edge for a close-up of the stones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph only what is visible from the path without approaching the water’s edge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの利用者の通行にもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please be considerate of other people using the path too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。石は動かさず、通る人を待ってから写真を撮ります。自然の配置のまま記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 石移動なしで通行者待機後自然配置を記録すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will leave the stones in place and wait for people to pass before taking photos. I will record their natural arrangement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the stones unmoved and record their natural arrangement after waiting for passersby. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、足元に気をつけて撮影をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy taking photos, then, and watch your footing. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご一緒の方をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for someone you are traveling with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が駅のベンチに本を忘れて、取りに戻りました。私はもうホームにいるので、どう合流するか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れた本を探す友人との合流を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend left a book on a station bench and went back for it. I am already on the platform, so I am unsure how we should meet up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about meeting your friend who is looking for a forgotten book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、お友達とは連絡が取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you contact your friend now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話はつながりました。本を探し終えるまで、私に先に乗ってほしいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話で先に乗るよう言われたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I reached my friend by phone. My friend says I should board first while they finish looking for the book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend told you by phone to board first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身は先に出発されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like to leave first yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は一緒に行きたいです。一本遅くなっても構わないので、今の電車は見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一緒に行くため今の電車を見送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to go together today. I do not mind taking a train one service later, so I will let this train go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will let the current train go so you can travel together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ホームの端で待ち続けず、安全な場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait somewhere safe instead of staying at the edge of the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このベンチで待ちます。友人に電車を見送ったと伝え、走って来なくていいと言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチで待ち急がなくてよいと友人に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait on this bench. I will tell my friend I let the train go and there is no need to run here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait on the bench and tell your friend there is no need to hurry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の電車に間に合うかは、お友達が戻られてから確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check whether you can catch the next train after your friend returns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。戻ってから二人で行先を確認します。本が見つからなくても、私だけ先に出発せず、ここで相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再会後に行先と次便を二人で相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We will check the destination together after my friend returns. Even if the book is not found, I will discuss things here instead of departing alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss the destination and next service together after meeting again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お二人そろってからお進みください。楽しいお出かけになりますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed once both of you are here, then. Have an enjoyable outing. Goodbye.
